text:
Predicates:
Hosted(x, y) ::: x hosted y.
SummerOlympics(y) ::: y is a Summer Olympics event.
WinterOlympics(y) ::: y is a Winter Olympics event.
University(x) ::: x is a university.
RankedAmongBest(x) ::: x ranks among the best universities in the world.
Location(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
CapitalOf(x, y) ::: x is the capital of y.
MostPopulousNations(y) ::: y is the most populous nation.

Premises:
CapitalOf(beijing, people's_republic_of_china) ∧ CapitalOf(beijing, world's_most_populous_nation) ::: Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China and the world's most populous nation.
Location(beijing, northern_china) ::: Beijing is located in Northern China.
Hosted(beijing, olympics2008_summer) ∧ Hosted(beijing, olympics2008_paralympics) ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Olympics and 2008 Summer Paralympics.
Hosted(beijing, olympics2008_summer) ∧ Hosted(beijing, olympics2008_winter) ::: Beijing has hosted the Summer and Winter Olympics.
Hosted(beijing, paralympics2008_summer) ∧ Hosted(beijing, paralympics2008_winter) ::: Beijing has hosted the Summer and Winter Paralympics.
∀x (University(x) → RankedAmongBest(x)) ::: Many of Beijing's 91 universities consistently rank among the best universities in the world.

Conclusion:
Hosted(beijing, olympics2008_summer) ∧ Hosted(beijing, olympics2008_winter) ::: Beijing hosted both the 2008 Summer Olympics and the Winter Olympics.
